item.title: Disability funding could be cut during 2026 legislative session
item.description: The 2026 legislative session is deliberating between ways to balance the state's budget, with disability services potentially on the chopping block.

item.title: Melania Trump’s documentary premieres at the Kennedy Center ahead of global release
item.description: Melania Trump is capping her first year back as first lady with the global release of "Melania," a documentary she produced about the 20 days leading up to her husband, President Donald Trump’s return to the White House.

item.title: Journalist Don Lemon is charged with federal civil rights crimes in anti-ICE church protest
item.description: Journalist Don Lemon was arrested after he entered a Minnesota church and recorded anti-immigration enforcement protesters who disrupted a service.

item.title: Judge bars federal prosecutors from seeking death penalty against Luigi Mangione
item.description: Federal prosecutors can't seek the death penalty against Luigi Mangione in the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, a judge ruled Friday.

item.title: DOJ has opened a federal civil rights probe into the death of Alex Pretti, deputy AG says
item.description: Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche said the Justice Department opened a federal civil rights investigation into the death of Alex Pretti.

item.title: Catherine O’Hara, Emmy-winning comedian of ‘Schitt’s Creek’ and ‘SCTV’ fame, dies at 71
item.description: Catherine O'Hara, Emmy-winning actor and comedian who starred in 'Schitt's Creek,' 'SCTV' and 'Home Alone,' dies at 71.

item.title: Utah nurses hold vigil for Minnesota man killed during immigration enforcement protest
item.description: Hundreds of Utah nurses and others gathered Thursday to honor Alex Pretti, a 37-year-old intensive care unit nurse who was shot and killed by Border Patrol officers in Minneapolis while protesting immigration enforcement.

item.title: High School Musical actor returns to East High after 20 years
item.description: Musical theatre students at East High got the surprise of their lives Thursday; while rehearsing for their upcoming production of "High School Musical", a familiar Wildcats alumnus stepped into the theater.

item.title: Skier dies after ‘serious incident’ at Park City Mountain Resort
item.description: On Friday, Park City officials confirmed the incident and said the skier was a 61-year-old female from Florida.

item.title: Thousands rally in downtown Salt Lake City for ‘ICE OUT’ protest, march to USCIS building
item.description: Thousands of protesters gathered in downtown Salt Lake City Friday afternoon for an “ICE OUT” demonstration that organizers said was part of a nationwide blackout calling attention to immigration enforcement and its impact on families and communities.
